text:
Jules: kicking off Solaris enterprise presales thread — need to align on run-rate, reserved GPUs vs burst credits, autoscale SLOs, and security questionnaire items.
Maria: Solaris procurement sent expected 95th pctl QPS = 2.1k sustained weekdays, spike to 8k for 3–5 mins twice/day. They use chat+embed mix (~70/30).
Sam: 2.1k sustained — what's avg tokens per request and embedding frequency?
Jules: avg request 120 tokens → ~250k tokens/min sustained. Embeddings 30% requests but heavier CPU. They want 99.9% p95 latency < 600ms.
Maria: pricing: they asked if reserved GPU commit reduces per-token by 22% vs hosted. Can we confirm? :money_with_wings: 
Sam: estimate yes for M60-ish fleet. Need exact model mix: 8k spike requires burst pool + prewarm. Suggest reserved pool sized for 4k steady with burst credits to 8k.
Lina: security Q: Solaris needs KMS integration, VPC peering, and SOC2 section filled. Also data residency EU. We can do Private but cost/ops heavier.
Jules: noted. For autoscale policy suggestion — draft snippet:
```
policy: mixed
reserved_capacity: 4k_rps
burst_credit: 4k_rps (replenish 1k/min)
kv_warmup: enabled (prefix cache, 20GB)
quantization_profile: int4 for embedding models, int8 for chat
fallback: smaller model variant (latency-safe)
```
Sam: kv_warmup and prefix caching will drop tail latency but increases preheat time — preheat window ~10m for 20GB KV on our infra.
Maria: Ops asks about preheat cadence during deploys — can we automate preheat with schedule in Dedicated?
Sam: yes — we can schedule preheat jobs via console; note spot eviction may interrupt KV warm caches. Recommend AZ spread and short prewarm cadence every 6h during ramp days.
Jules: procurement also wants a runbook if reserved pool hits 90% — propose automatic overflow to burst pool + notify ops + canary downgrade to quantized variant.
Sam: propose alerts:
- reserved_usage > 85% -> warn (ops channel)
- > 95% -> auto-burst + scale-up request
- sustained > 10m at >95% -> exec auto-fallback
Maria: can we draft SLA language for burst overflow and preheat windows for the term sheet?
Lina: add KMS integration timeline (2 weeks) and SOC2 docs delivery (3 business days to provide evidence). Also need data flow diagram.
Jules: thanks — I'll draft a single-page tech appendix covering: run-rate math, autoscale policy, preheat schedule, fallback behaviors, and security deliverables. Assigning action items:
- Maria: confirm contract delta for reserved pricing (P1)
- Sam: produce autoscale+alert JSON and preheat timing (P1)
- Lina: list exact sec artifacts for legal (P2)
- Jules: assemble tech appendix and send to Solaris this afternoon.
Maria: on it. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: preheat job scheduled for test cluster at 2026-03-23T15:00Z (dry-run)
Sam: I'll drop the autoscale JSON in the docs channel and ping here when ready.
Jules: great — circling back after docs and legal inputs. thanks everyone.
